scripts.test: forge test -vvv --gas-report | tee ./results/test.log && grep -A1 '^|.*|$' ./results/test.log > ./results/gas-report.txt && yarn disabled
scripts.coverage: forge coverage --report summary --report lcov | tee ./results/coverage.log && grep '\(-\|^| \(src/\|Total \|File \).* |$\)' ./results/coverage.log > ./results/coverage.txt && lcov --extract ./lcov.info --output-file lcov.info 'src/*'
